module todo_cli
  purpose: Keep a to-do list in a text file from the command line.

import std.console
import std.environment
import std.filesystem exposing Path, FileError

let todo_path: Path be Path("todo.txt")

public type Command is one of
  purpose: What the user asked for.
  Add(task: Text)
  Done(position: Integer where position is at least 1)
  Show
  Help
end

public function parse_command(arguments: List of Text) returns Command
  purpose: Turn command-line words into a command; anything unrecognized is Help.
  example: parse_command(["add", "buy", "milk"]) is Add(task: "buy milk")
  example: parse_command(["done", "2"]) is Done(position: 2)
  example: parse_command([]) is Help

  # ... body removed ...
end

function load_tasks() returns List of Text needs filesystem.read
  let text be filesystem.read_text(todo_path) otherwise ""
  return for each line in text.lines() where line.trim() is not "" collect line
end

function save_tasks(tasks: List of Text) or fails with FileError needs filesystem.write
  filesystem.write_text(path: todo_path, content: tasks.join("\n")) otherwise fail
end

function show_tasks(tasks: List of Text) needs console
  for each task, position in tasks.with_index()
    console.print("{position + 1}. {task}")
  end
end

public function main() or fails with FileError needs console, environment, filesystem
  purpose: Run one command and show the resulting list.

  let tasks be load_tasks()
  match parse_command(environment.arguments())
    when Add(task) then
      let updated be tasks.append(task)
      save_tasks(updated) otherwise fail
      show_tasks(updated)
    when Done(position) then
      let updated be tasks.without_index(position - 1)
      save_tasks(updated) otherwise fail
      show_tasks(updated)
    when Show then show_tasks(tasks)
    when Help then console.print("usage: todo add <task> | todo done <number> | todo show")
  end
end
